Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL3751755. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to enforce structure availability. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3751755'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and return all matching rows.
